Scale: the plate is square and cropped, so I can't see all of it. It's probably a side plate of about 20-25 cm. The image is roughly 1024 px wide, and the visible plate section looks about 20 cm across.

Sweet potatoes: the cubes cover an area of about 270 x 400 px. At roughly 50 px per cm, that is about 5 x 8 cm. There are about 10 pieces, each about 3 x 2 x 1 cm, so about 6 cm³ each. That gives roughly 60 cm³, or about 60 g. Allowing for the oil they were roasted in, I'll say 70 g.

Egg whites: the scrambled mass covers about 450 x 500 px, or roughly 9 x 10 cm, with a height of about 2 cm. That is about 100-130 cm³ of loose, airy egg. At a density of about 0.7 that is roughly 90 g. I'll say 100 g.

Cooked egg whites are about 50 kcal per 100 g. Roasted sweet potato is about 130 kcal per 100 g, or about 150 with oil.
